title: HiUni: Harmonizing Understanding and Generation in Shared Visual Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.26107v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unified multimodal models aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single framework. However, prevailing approaches often separate their visual representations or backbone computation to accommodate the different requirements of these two tasks, which limits the degree of unification. In this paper, we present HiUni, which revisits this design choice and explores whether a pretrained vision language model can be directly extended into a unified model with extensive parameter sharing. Specifically, HiUni reuses the same language-aligned ViT and dense Transformer backbone for both capabilities, while confining task-specific computation to the output side. Yet such a design introduces two key challenges. Generation in pixel space is difficult to optimize, and semantic abstraction in pretrained ViT discards fine spatial details required for synthesis. translated_title: HiUni：在共享视觉空间中协调理解与生成
translated_abstract: 统一多模态模型旨在在单一框架内同时支持视觉理解与生成。然而，主流方法往往将视觉表示或骨干网络计算分离开来，以适应这两项任务的不同需求，这限制了模型统一化的程度。本文提出 HiUni，重新审视这一设计选择，并探索预训练视觉语言模型能否通过广泛的参数共享直接扩展为一个统一模型。具体而言，HiUni 为理解与生成两种能力复用同一个与语言对齐的 ViT 和密集 Transformer 骨干网络，同时将任务特定的计算限制在输出端。然而这样的设计带来了两个关键挑战：像素空间中的生成难以优化，且预训练 ViT 的语义抽象会丢弃图像合成所需的细粒度空间细节。为应对这些挑战，HiUni 引入了像素扩散机制（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: HiUni 通过让理解与生成任务共享同一个语言对齐的 ViT 和密集 Transformer 骨干网络、仅将任务特定计算放在输出端，并借助像素扩散机制解决优化困难与细节丢失问题，实现了高度参数共享的统一多模态模型。
en_tdlr: HiUni unifies visual understanding and generation by extensively sharing the same language-aligned ViT and dense Transformer backbone, confining task-specific computation to the output side, and introducing pixel diffusion to overcome optimization difficulty and loss of fine spatial details.
